metricDefinitions.label: College-age proxy
metricDefinitions.definition: Source age field 18–24 inclusive. The 18–22 alternative is a sensitivity check; neither is a student enrollment flag.

metricDefinitions.label: Campus site
metricDefinitions.definition: TA - NCSU TALLEY STUDENT CENTER in 2022 and 2024; NCSU WESTERN BLVD BUSINESS SERVICES in 2026.

metricDefinitions.label: Matched-day index
metricDefinitions.definition: 2026 cumulative ballots through day d divided by selected historical year cumulative ballots through day d, multiplied by 100.

metricDefinitions.label: Individual-age share
metricDefinitions.definition: Accepted ballots of the given age divided by all ages at that same year’s campus site, times 100.

metricDefinitions.label: 2024 presidential benchmark
metricDefinitions.definition: For the same first 16 early-voting days: 2026 accepted ballot count divided by 2024 accepted ballot count, times 100; separately for Wake County and campus sites, for all ages and ages 18–24. This is a ballot-volume ratio, not a registered-voter turnout rate, target or forecast.

metricDefinitions.label: Same-day registration versus ballot volume
metricDefinitions.definition: All accepted campus-site early ballots, all ages, over the matched first 16 days. Same-day registration counts records with sdr equal to Y or YES. Share = same-day-registration ballots / all site ballots * 100. Count change = (2026 count / selected baseline count - 1) * 100; share change = 2026 unrounded share - baseline unrounded share, in percentage points. Registration ballots are a subset of all ballots; do not add them. The measure does not identify students or count all new voter registrations. Source cohorts and counts are unchanged.

metricDefinitions.label: Distinct denominators and expanded comparisons
metricDefinitions.definition: Site count = accepted ballots in the selected age group at the campus site. Site age mix = campus-site ballots ages 18–24 / all campus-site ballots * 100. Share of Wake college-age ballots = campus-site ballots ages 18–24 / all Wake ballots ages 18–24 * 100. None is turnout among registered or eligible residents. Expanded comparisons retain both baselines, all three disjoint-or-containing scopes, all-age and overlapping age/registration cohorts; count difference = current - baseline; growth = difference / baseline * 100. Shares use the explicit scope or same-cohort county denominator; differences are unrounded percentage points. Never add containing scopes or overlapping cohorts.

metricDefinitions.label: College-age proxy
metricDefinitions.definition: Source age field 18–24 inclusive. The 18–22 alternative is a sensitivity check; neither is a student enrollment flag.

metricDefinitions.label: Campus site
metricDefinitions.definition: TA - NCSU TALLEY STUDENT CENTER in 2022 and 2024; NCSU WESTERN BLVD BUSINESS SERVICES in 2026.

metricDefinitions.label: Matched-day index
metricDefinitions.definition: 2026 cumulative ballots through day d divided by selected historical year cumulative ballots through day d, multiplied by 100.

metricDefinitions.label: Individual-age share
metricDefinitions.definition: Accepted ballots of the given age divided by all ages at that same year’s campus site, times 100.

metricDefinitions.label: Age-group ballot shares
metricDefinitions.definition: Talley Student Union in selected baseline year (2022 by default, also 2024) compared with Western Boulevard Business Services in 2026. First 16 early-voting days in each year. Share = age-group accepted ballots / all accepted ballots at that site in that year * 100. The single share column displays Talley share followed by Western Boulevard share; subordinate counts preserve the underlying ballots. Difference = 2026 share minus baseline share, in percentage points, calculated before rounding. Age order is fixed; ages 18-24 are highlighted. This measures the composition of site users, not countywide share, registered-voter turnout, or a causal effect of the move. 2022 and 2026 are midterms; 2024 is presidential. Each displayed share includes the visible numerator, denominator, and multiplication by 100. The all-site-ballots row is the denominator and sums each mutually exclusive age group.

metricDefinitions.label: Voter-profile ballot shares
metricDefinitions.definition: Source party registration, gender, race, and ethnicity are selectable, separate exhaustive breakdowns of accepted campus-site ballots for the same selected historical baseline and 2026. Share = category ballots / all accepted ballots at that site in that year * 100; difference is 2026 share minus baseline share in percentage points before rounding. Party registration groups DEM, REP, UNA separately and sums all remaining parties into Other registered parties. All recorded unknown or undesignated categories remain included. A category absent in one year is zero after its full dimension reconciles to that year site total. No reviewed source rows change. These characteristics do not identify candidate choice, student enrollment, or the causal effect of the polling-site move.

evidenceFlow.title: Count and accumulate
evidenceFlow.detail: scripts/build_party_trends.py verifies original CSV SHA-256 hashes, counts accepted early-voting records by return date and party registration, then computes running totals. Every day reconciles to matched_daily.csv; all-age party totals reconcile to matched_demographics.csv. Only aggregates are exported.

metricDefinitions.label: Daily accepted ballots
metricDefinitions.definition: Each matching original record contributes one ballot to its return date, party-registration group, selected scope and age cohort.

metricDefinitions.label: Cumulative ballots
metricDefinitions.definition: For one year, scope, age cohort and party group, cumulative ballots equal the sum of daily ballots from day 1 through the displayed date. This is a running total, not a turnout rate.

metricDefinitions.label: Party registration
metricDefinitions.definition: DEM = Democratic; REP = Republican; UNA = Unaffiliated. All remaining nonblank registration codes form Other registered parties. Blank codes remain Not specified if observed. Registration does not reveal candidate choice.

metricDefinitions.label: Separate age bands
metricDefinitions.definition: 18–24, 25–34, 35–44, 45–64 and 65–120 do not overlap. Unknown or outside-range ages remain in the all-age total. The legacy 18–22 sensitivity rows are retained in the CSV but are not a separate age-menu band.

metricDefinitions.label: Shared scale ceiling
metricDefinitions.definition: The guide is the highest final cumulative party count among 2022, 2024 and 2026 for the selected scope and age band. The same reviewed maximum sets all three vertical scales; it is not an extra ballot series.

metricDefinitions.label: Final counts, shares and changes
metricDefinitions.definition: Final values use the last matched early-voting day for each year. Share = category count / all selected ballots * 100; count change = 2026 count - baseline count; growth = count change / baseline count * 100; share change = unrounded 2026 share - baseline share, in percentage points. Comparisons retain both 2022 and 2024 baselines. Zero denominators display N/A.

evidenceFlow.title: Recount and reconcile
evidenceFlow.detail: scripts/build_sdr_trends.py verifies every original CSV hash, independently counts sdr Y/YES by day and age, checks each subset against party-derived ballot denominators, all-age totals against the existing summary, age partitions and scope partitions. Only aggregates are exported.

metricDefinitions.label: Same-day-registration ballots
metricDefinitions.definition: Accepted early-voting records with sdr equal to Y or YES, by original return date, matched first 16 days, selected location and age band. These ballots are already included in total ballots; this is not a count of every new registration.

metricDefinitions.label: Running registration count
metricDefinitions.formula: cumulative(day) = sum(votes from day 1 through day)
metricDefinitions.definition: Each matching original ballot contributes one. Ages 18–24 are a proxy, not verified student status.

metricDefinitions.label: Registration share and comparisons
metricDefinitions.formula: share = cumulative / cumulative_ballots × 100; count change = 2026 − baseline; growth = count change / baseline × 100; share change = unrounded 2026 share − baseline share
metricDefinitions.definition: Shares use all accepted ballots in the SAME location, age band and period. A zero denominator has no defined share or growth. Share differences are percentage points.

metricDefinitions.label: Final counts, shares and changes
metricDefinitions.definition: Final values use the last matched early-voting day for each year. Share = category count / all selected ballots * 100; count change = 2026 count - baseline count; growth = count change / baseline count * 100; share change = unrounded 2026 share - baseline share, in percentage points. Comparisons retain both 2022 and 2024 baselines. Zero denominators display N/A.

evidenceFlow.title: Recount and reconcile
evidenceFlow.detail: scripts/build_geography.py verifies source hashes and unique accepted records locally, groups only precinct or residential ZIP with age and year, checks site + other = Wake, disjoint age bands, and every year/dimension/cohort against reviewed party-derived denominators. No names, addresses or identifiers are exported.

metricDefinitions.label: Residential area
metricDefinitions.definition: Precinct uses precinct_desc; ZIP code uses voter_zip, not a mailing-address field. Original trimmed field text is retained; blank is Unknown / blank. These are recorded residence groups, not the voting site precinct or verified NC State student residence.

metricDefinitions.label: Same-area location use
metricDefinitions.formula: site_share_pct = site_ballots / wake_ballots * 100; wake_ballots = site_ballots + other_wake_ballots
metricDefinitions.definition: For one residential area, year and age band, denominator is its accepted early ballots at ANY Wake location in the matched window. Site is Talley in 2022/2024 and Western Boulevard in 2026. This is site choice among observed early ballots, not resident turnout. Share differences subtract unrounded shares.

metricDefinitions.label: Absent versus zero
metricDefinitions.definition: If an area label has no accepted early ballots of any age in a year, area_present is false and all counts are null. Zero is used only for a cohort within an otherwise observed area. Null shares occur when cohort ballots are zero. Absence does not establish when a precinct was created.

metricDefinitions.label: Comparability
metricDefinitions.definition: Precinct boundaries/labels, populations, ZIP composition and election cycles may change. These independent yearly cohorts do not prove the same individuals switched locations. 2024 is presidential; 2022/2026 are midterms. Mail and Election Day ballots and registered-population denominators are absent.

metricDefinitions.label: Chart selection
metricDefinitions.definition: Rank residential areas by their combined named-site ballots across all three selected years, and show up to ten matching the search. The full table is searchable and paginated. Count and share chart modes use the same areas.
